title: Step 6 — publish-string invariant property tests (no ground truth, judgment)
instruction: Write backend/src/domain/distribution/taste/generation/__tests__/publish-string-invariant.test.ts implementing the property tests Step 6 describes. This repo has a hard rule: a test whose only assertions are .not.toBe / .not.toEqual is forbidden, because 'output changed' is satisfied by a wrong implementation. Assert actual values. Use vitest. Output the complete test file.
